preferences.name: preferences
preferences.description: Manage phantom user preferences stored in git config (global)

examples.description: Set the AI assistant preference (stored as phantom.ai in git config --global)
Store a custom worktreesDirectory (relative to the Git repository root) for all commands
Store a separator for flattening worktree directory names while keeping branch names unchanged
Keep branches by default when deleting worktrees with phantom delete or MCP
Disable automatic project discovery through ghq

notes: Subcommands:
get <key>    Show a preference value
set <key>    Set a preference value
remove <key> Remove a preference value
Preferences are saved in git config with the 'phantom.' prefix (global scope).
Supported keys:
ai - used by 'phantom ai'
worktreesDirectory - path relative to the Git repo root for storing worktrees (defaults to .git/phantom/worktrees)
directoryNameSeparator - replaces '/' in worktree directory names only (defaults to / for nested directories)
keepBranch - keeps the branch when deleting a worktree (defaults to false)
ghqDiscovery - discovers ghq-managed repositories as projects (defaults to true)

preferences get.name: preferences get
preferences get.description: Show a preference value (reads git config --global phantom.<key>)

examples.description: Show the AI assistant preference

notes: Supported keys: ai, worktreesDirectory, directoryNameSeparator, keepBranch, ghqDiscovery

preferences set.name: preferences set
preferences set.description: Set a preference value (writes git config --global phantom.<key>)

examples.description: Configure the AI assistant command
Store worktrees in ../phantom-worktrees relative to the Git repository root
Flatten worktree directory names such as feature/test to feature-test
Keep branches when deleting worktrees by default
Disable automatic project discovery through ghq

notes: Supported keys: ai, worktreesDirectory, directoryNameSeparator, keepBranch, ghqDiscovery
For worktreesDirectory, provide a path relative to the Git repository root; defaults to .git/phantom/worktrees when unset
For directoryNameSeparator, '/' keeps nested directories; any other string replaces '/' only in the directory path
For keepBranch, use true to preserve branches on delete or false to keep the default branch deletion behavior
For ghqDiscovery, use false to list only projects registered directly with Phantom

project.name: project

examples.description: Register the current Git repository
List available projects for an AI agent
Remove a project from the registry

notes: Available subcommands: add, list, remove
Removing a project only updates Phantom's registry; it never deletes the Git repository.

project add.name: project add
project add.description: Register a Git repository as a Phantom project
notes: When path is omitted, the current directory is used.
Adding an already registered repository succeeds without creating a duplicate.

project list.name: project list
project list.description: List registered and discovered Phantom projects

options.name: json
options.description: Output a versioned JSON object for automation

notes: Only one output format option can be used at a time.
Repositories managed by ghq are discovered automatically unless the ghqDiscovery preference is false.
ghq is optional; when it is not installed, only registered projects are listed.

project remove.name: project remove
project remove.description: Remove a Git project from Phantom's registry
notes: The project can be specified by id, name, or root path.
If a name matches multiple projects, use an id or path instead.
This command never deletes the Git repository or its worktrees.
A repository discovered through ghq remains visible after its registry record is removed.
